title: Guest Wi-Fi and member network
text: The guest network is Canal-Guest. No shared password is required: open a browser and accept the captive portal terms. Members use Canal-Member and can retrieve their personal credentials in the portal. Reception can help with sign-in during staffed hours.

title: Printing quota and poster printing
text: Standard members get 30 black-and-white pages per calendar month; Studio members get 60. Each additional black-and-white page costs $0.08. Reception can print A3 posters at $2 each during staffed hours. Unused monthly printing credits expire at month end.

title: Parcel delivery and collection
text: Studio members can receive business parcels at reception. Parcels must weigh at most 10 kg; storage lasts up to five business days. Bring a badge when collecting a parcel. Reception cannot accept refrigerated deliveries or sign for registered mail.

title: Bicycle storage and charging
text: Members can lock bicycles in the covered courtyard rack during their access hours. Entry is through the west gate. The rack cannot be reserved, and no outlets are available for e-bike charging. Remove bicycles before the end of the day.

title: Day passes and equipment loans
text: A day pass costs $18 and includes a hot desk and guest Wi-Fi for that day. Borrow a USB-C adapter at reception for up to three hours by leaving an access badge or visitor badge. Day passes do not include meeting room booking credits.
